component.name: WhatsAppGo
component.summary: A low-memory native WhatsApp client for Linux

description.p: WhatsAppGo is an unofficial Linux-first WhatsApp client. A native Qt interface automatically manages its bundled Go backend, which uses the WhatsApp multi-device protocol.
It supports linked-device login, text and media messages, local history, replies, reactions, receipts, typing indicators, search, and desktop notifications. Voice and video calls are not supported.

Show a centered unread-message count above the first unread message in both themes. Keep the divider stable across read receipts and older history pages, preserve arrivals during chat loading, and reject stale opening responses.

Restore chat-tail navigation, compact captioned media and clear stale typing indicators. Preserve attachment replies after failed sends, isolate image-copy completions and correct download cancellation accounting. Open WhatsAppGo GitHub issues directly for bug reports.
Preserve failed-send drafts, edits, deletions, rich metadata and older attachments. Fix image zoom, privacy synchronization and mark-all-read pagination. Submit bug reports to the WhatsAppGo intake.
